thought.text:
**Temuan besar!** Signup AllModels pakai **Cloudflare Turnstile**, bukan reCAPTCHA:

```javascript
const N = "0x4AAAAAAFoFe99_cOH0RnFT"    // Turnstile sitekey
const ae = "x-turnstile-token"           // header
action: "signup"
```

Ini kabar baik — Turnstile jauh lebih mudah. Saya uji langsung.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
from capsolve import solve_turnstile
t=solve_turnstile("https://dash.allmodels.io/signup","0x4AAAAAAFoFe99_cOH0RnFT")
print("token len:",len(t)); print(t[:60])
open('/tmp/ts.txt','w').write(t)
PY
